subject: Deadline confirmation needed
text: As a family friend, I am following up after two days because I need an answer on the final deadline. The project brief says submission is due noon Friday, but the seminar schedule lists Friday evening for peer review. Please confirm which time controls for the graded draft. I also need to know whether the extension request changes the final exam date or only the paper. I understand you have classes, so a short line is enough: draft by noon, peer review by six, and exam unchanged. With those details, I can plan the weekend and avoid guessing.
